policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O expands partnership with ServiceNow
items.summary: ServiceNow will integrate O models/agents into workflows from development to security, including a new integration bringing context and workflow actions into ChatGPT. Reinforces enterprise distribution and ongoing agentic deployment efforts.

items.headline: O launches atlassian partnership expansion
items.summary: Atlassian and O expanded their partnership to bring GPT‑6 family models into the Atlassian platform, aiming to power AI experiences for teams planning/building/delivering work—another enterprise embedding signal.

items.headline: O expands partnership with Oracle
items.summary: O and Oracle expanded efforts to bring Oracle apps/data into ChatGPT and to power new Oracle offerings using O models. Cites Oracle’s active ChatGPT/Codex user counts, implying continued enterprise demand momentum.

items.headline: G adds limited preview for Muse Spark Open
items.summary: GroqCloud limited preview now includes Meta’s Muse Spark Open via G-hosted deployment docs, signaling ongoing inference platform expansion for new open-weight models.
